operationName: Operation Swords of Iron (Israel) / October 7 War
heroHeadline: IDF Kills Abu Mlouh Family Including 1-Year-Old in Nuseirat; Police Station Strike Kills 7; France Bans Ben-Gvir — Day 956
heroSubtitle: On Day 956 of the Gaza war (May 24, 2026), an Israeli airstrike on a Nuseirat refugee camp apartment killed the Abu Mlouh family of three — father, mother, and their 1-year-old son — at dawn. A separate strike on a central Gaza police station killed 7 including 5 officers and a child. On Day 955 (May 23), overnight strikes hit Nuseirat and Bureij refugee camps injuring dozens; an IDF strike killed 5 Hamas officers at a northern Gaza police post; and France announced an immediate travel ban barring National Security Minister Ben-Gvir from all French territory over his treatment of flotilla activists. The IDF has now destroyed multiple Hamas weapons depots in central Gaza during the renewed campaign. The UN reported only 906 aid truckloads reached Gaza since Israel's Rafah operation began, with the 2026 Flash Appeal only 13% funded. Gaza's cumulative death toll remains 73,800+ confirmed killed since October 7, 2023.
